title: Probabilistic canary evaluator with drift detection and auto-remediation
creator: Leila Chen
description: Implement a probabilistic canary evaluation service that continuously monitors quality regressions during Canary and A/B exposures and performs automated remediation when statistical evidence of degradation is observed. The service should support multi-metric hypothesis testing (accuracy proxies, latency percentiles, hallucination rates), per-cohort baselines, and short-window drift detection using bootstrapped confidence intervals. Auto-remediation actions include staged traffic scale-down, model variant fallback, and full rollback. Primary goal: reduce time-to-remediation for silent regressions while avoiding false-positive rollbacks that impact product availability.
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight evaluator microservice that consumes sampled inference traces and metric streams from Console tracing hooks. For each rolling window (default 10k requests or 15 minutes), compute bootstrap CIs for key metrics and perform pairwise nonparametric comparisons against the control cohort using permutation tests and a Benjamini-Hochberg style false-discovery adjustment across metrics. Implement drift detection via exponentially weighted moving average on residuals and an outlier detector for sudden distributional shifts (KL divergence on embedding distributions). Remediation policy engine will first attempt traffic cutbacks by percentiles (50%, 80%) with safeties for min-capacity. If degradation persists after N cycles, issue automatic rollback to prior stable model version and create an incident with attached eval snapshot. Expose config knobs in Console and wire audit events to the Private control plane for on-prem visibility.
acceptance_criteria: Evaluator ingests sampled traces and computes metrics within 30s of window close
Statistical test pipeline produces p-values and corrected alerts with reproducible seeds
Remediation engine can reduce canary traffic by configured steps and escalate to rollback after policy thresholds
End-to-end integration test that simulates a synthetic regression results in automated traffic reduction and a rollback in staging
Dashboard shows per-cohort metric trends, CI bands, and decision provenance for every remediation action
comments: 2026-02-28 - Initial ticket created by Leila. Motivation: recent silent quality dips in language-routing experiments; need faster automatic containment without ripping prod traffic manually.
2026-03-02 - Architecture sync: agreed to use bootstrap CI + permutation tests rather than parametric t-tests to reduce assumptions on metric distributions. Marcus to prototype sampling hooks.
2026-03-04 - Design review notes: PM requests exposing per-customer thresholds and an allowlist to disable auto-remediation for VIP tenants. Added as label and config requirement.

2026-03-06 - Spike complete: prototype ingestion using kinesis stream -> evaluator service can compute bootstrap intervals for ROUGE-like metric in ~12s for 5k samples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evaluator/pull/84

2026-03-09 - Decision: use Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control across metrics to avoid noisy multi-metric rollback triggers. Also add KL divergence detector on embedding layer to capture distributional shift.

2026-03-11 - Integration plan: wire evaluator outputs to rollout controller (ENG-51723). Need a minimal API contract: {cohort, metrics, ci_low, ci_high, p_values, decision, provenance_url}. Marcus to draft OpenAPI schema.
2026-03-12 - Blocking: need visibility into sampling fraction per-route (Console feature request). Filed PM ticket to prioritize sampling telemetry in console (PM-812).
notes: Prototype results indicated bootstrap sample size of 5k gives stable CI for our accuracy proxies; smaller cohorts need adjusted thresholds to avoid false alarms.
Fallback actions prioritized: 1) percent traffic cutback, 2) route to compatible cheaper model variant, 3) full rollback. Each step is logged with decision provenance for audits.

Operational concern: must support private deployments where metrics may be on-prem; plan to include optional local aggregator that mirrors anonymized eval snapshots to control plane over an encrypted channel.
